Players Committee card image of [[Keep Your Eyes Open (V)]] (original printing), game text: “USED: Cancel an attempt to fire a weapon during any move phase. LOST: If a battle was just initiated, lose 1 Force to prevent all weapons from being fired for remainder of battle.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/keepyoureyesopen.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
